# Setup

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ggridges)
library(ggalluvial)
library(forcats)
library(HDAnalyzeR)
library(ggConvexHull)
library(UpSetR)
library(ggridges)
library(ggbeeswarm)

# Specify function
select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter
mutate <- dplyr::mutate
rename <- dplyr::rename

# Set ggplot2 defaults
ggplot2::update_geom_defaults(
  "point",
  list(size = 2, alpha = 0.6)
)

# Source scripts
source("../scripts/functions/themes_palettes.R")
source("../scripts/functions/functions_disease_analyses.R")

# Read data
metadata <- read_csv("../data/curated/metadata.csv")
data_long <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_long.csv")
data_wide <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_wide.csv")
data_long_ml <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_long_ml.csv")
data_wide_ml <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_wide_ml.csv")
```

# Figure 4

## Figure 4A

```{r}
input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Timepoint != "Baseline") |> 
  filter(Subgroup %in% c("Primary HIV infection", "More preserved immunity", "Severely impaired immunity", "Healthy")) |>
  mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age), `Age (baseline)`, Age)) |>
  mutate(BMI = ifelse(is.na(BMI), `BMI (baseline)`, BMI))

input_data <- data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)

hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(dat = input_data, 
                        metadata = input_metadata, 
                        is_wide = TRUE, 
                        sample_id = "DAid",
                        var_name = "Feature",
                        value_name = "NPX")

de_results <- hd_de_limma(hd_obj, 
                          variable = "Disease", 
                          case = "HIV", 
                          control = "Healthy", 
                          correct = c("Age", "Sex")) |> 
  hd_plot_volcano(pval_lim = 0.05,
                  logfc_lim = 0.5,
                  top_up_prot = 10,
                  top_down_prot = 5,
                  title = "PLWH (at follow-up) vs. Healthy",
                  report_nproteins = FALSE,
                  user_defined_proteins = NULL)

de_res_hiv_fu_healthy <- de_results$de_res

p <- de_results$volcano_plot +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "significant down" = "#317EC2",
      "significant up"   = "#C03830",
      "not significant"  = "#C4C4C4"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "significant down" = "Significantly decreased",
      "significant up"   = "Significantly increased",
      "not significant"  = "Not significant"
    ),
    name = NULL   # removes legend title ("Significance")
  ) +
  labs(
    y = expression(-log[10]("adjusted p-value")),
    x = expression(log[2]("fold change"))
  )

p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$size   <- 3
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$alpha  <- 0.7
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$stroke <- 0

p

p_volcano_hiv_fu_healthy <- p
```

```{r}
input_metadata |>
  group_by(Disease, Subgroup) |>
  summarise(n = n())
```

## Figure 4D

```{r}
input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Treatment %in% "INSTI + Abacavir" & Timepoint == "Follow-up" | Disease == "Healthy") |>
  mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age), `Age (follow-up)`, Age)) |>
  mutate(BMI = ifelse(is.na(BMI), `BMI (follow-up)`, BMI)) |>
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |>
  # Mutate Follow-up to FU in Timepoint
  mutate(Timepoint = ifelse(Timepoint == "Follow-up", "FU", Timepoint))

input_data <- data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)

hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(dat = input_data, 
                        metadata = input_metadata, 
                        is_wide = TRUE, 
                        sample_id = "DAid",
                        var_name = "Feature",
                        value_name = "NPX")

de_results <- hd_de_limma(hd_obj, 
                          variable = "Timepoint", 
                          case = "FU", 
                          control = "Healthy", 
                          correct = c("Age", "Sex")

  hd_plot_volcano(pval_lim = 0.05,

                  top_up_prot = 10,
                  top_down_prot = 5,
                  title = "PLWH on INSTI + Abacavir (at follow-up) vs. Healthy",
                  report_nproteins = FALSE,

p <- de_results$volcano_plot +
  theme_hiv() +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "significant down" = "#317EC2",
      "significant up"   = "#C03830",
      "not significant"  = "#C4C4C4"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "significant down" = "Significantly decreased",
      "significant up"   = "Significantly increased",
      "not significant"  = "Not significant"
    ),
    name = NULL   # removes legend title ("Significance")
  ) +
  labs(
    y = expression(-log[10]("adjusted p-value")),
    x = expression(log[2]("fold change"))
  )

p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$size   <- 3
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$alpha  <- 0.7
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$stroke <- 0

p

p_volcano_instiaa_fu_healthy <- p
```

## Figure 4G

```{r}
res_instiaa_fu_healthy
res_instite_fu_healthy
res_nnrtite_fu_healthy

cvd_healthy_res
met_healthy_res

# Identify CVD set of significant proteins
cvd_sig_proteins <- cvd_healthy_res |>
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & abs(logFC) > 0.5) |>
  pull(Feature)

# Identify Met set of significant proteins
met_sig_proteins <- met_healthy_res |>
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & abs(logFC) > 0.5) |>
  pull(Feature)

# Identify CVD & Met overlapping significant proteins
overlap_sig_proteins <- intersect(cvd_sig_proteins, met_sig_proteins)

fdr_cutoff   <- 0.05
logfc_cutoff <- 0.5

cvd_sig_proteins <- cvd_healthy_res |>
  filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
  pull(Feature)

met_sig_proteins <- met_healthy_res |>
  filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
  pull(Feature)

overlap_sig_proteins <- intersect(cvd_sig_proteins, met_sig_proteins)

cvd_only_proteins <- setdiff(cvd_sig_proteins, met_sig_proteins)
met_only_proteins <- setdiff(met_sig_proteins, cvd_sig_proteins)

extract_logfc <- function(res_df, comparison_name) {
  res_df |>
    select(Feature, logFC, adj.P.Val) |>
    mutate(
      Comparison = comparison_name,
      Significant = adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff & abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff
    )
}

logfc_long <- bind_rows(
  extract_logfc(de_res_hiv_fu_healthy, "HIV (FU) vs Healthy"),
  extract_logfc(cvd_healthy_res,        "CVD vs Healthy"),
  extract_logfc(met_healthy_res,        "MET vs Healthy"),
  extract_logfc(res_instiaa_fu_healthy, "INSTI + Abacavir"),
  extract_logfc(res_instite_fu_healthy, "INSTI + Tenofovir"),
  extract_logfc(res_nnrtite_fu_healthy, "NNRTI + Tenofovir")
)

heatmap_df <- logfc_long |>
  filter(
    Feature %in% c(
      overlap_sig_proteins,
      met_only_proteins,
      cvd_only_proteins
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Block = case_when(
      Feature %in% overlap_sig_proteins ~ "CVD & MET",
      Feature %in% met_only_proteins     ~ "MET only",
      Feature %in% cvd_only_proteins     ~ "CVD only"
    ),
    Block = factor(
      Block,
      levels = c("CVD & MET", "MET only", "CVD only")
    )
  )

protein_order <- heatmap_df |>
  group_by(Feature, Block) |>
  summarise(mean_abs_logFC = mean(abs(logFC), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(Block, desc(mean_abs_logFC)) |>
  pull(Feature)

heatmap_df <- heatmap_df |>
  mutate(
    Feature = factor(Feature, levels = protein_order),
    Comparison = factor(
      Comparison,
      levels = c(
        "CVD vs Healthy",
        "MET vs Healthy",
        "HIV (FU) vs Healthy",
        "INSTI + Abacavir",
        "INSTI + Tenofovir",
        "NNRTI + Tenofovir"
      )
    )
  )

library(ggplot2)

p_heatmap <- ggplot(
  heatmap_df,
  aes(x = Comparison, y = Feature, fill = logFC)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +

  # ⭐ significance overlay
  geom_text(
    data = dplyr::filter(heatmap_df, Significant),
    label = "*",
    color = "black",
    size  = 3
  ) +

  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(Block),
    scales = "free_y",
    space  = "free_y"
  ) +

  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "logFC"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_heatmap
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# Proteins of interest
# ---------------------------
highlighted_proteins <- c(
  "FABP1", "FABP2", "IL6", "LEP",
  
  "IGFBP1", "IGFBP2", "SULT2A1", "GDF15",
  
  "IRAG2", "AGRP", "S100A12", "CTSH"
)

# ---------------------------
# Treatments of interest
# ---------------------------
treatment_order <- c(
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir",
  "INSTI + Abacavir"
)

# ---------------------------
# Colors (cohort-level)
# ---------------------------
group_colors <- c(
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir"  = "#D55E00",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir"  = "#0072B2",
  "INSTI + Abacavir"   = "#CC79A7",
  "Healthy"            = "#BDBDBD",
  "Cardiovascular"     = "#FC8D62",
  "Metabolic"          = "#E5C494"
)

# ---------------------------
# Prepare plotting data
# ---------------------------
p_up <- data_long |>
  select(DAid, Feature, NPX) |>
  inner_join(
    metadata,
    by = "DAid"
  ) |>
  filter(
    Feature %in% highlighted_proteins,
    Treatment %in% treatment_order |
      Subgroup %in% c(
        "Healthy",
        "Cardiovascular",
        "Metabolic"
      )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Feature = factor(Feature, levels = highlighted_proteins),

    # -----------------------
    # X-axis grouping logic
    # -----------------------
    Group_time = case_when(
      Subgroup == "Healthy"          ~ "Healthy",
      Subgroup == "Cardiovascular"   ~ "Cardiovascular",
      Subgroup == "Metabolic"        ~ "Metabolic",
      TRUE ~ paste(Treatment, Timepoint, sep = " – ")
    ),

    # For consistent coloring
    Group_color = case_when(
      Subgroup %in% c(
        "Healthy",
        "Cardiovascular",
        "Metabolic",
        "Elite controller"
      ) ~ Subgroup,
      TRUE ~ Treatment
    )
  )

# ---------------------------
# Explicit x-axis order
# ---------------------------
x_order <- c(
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir – Baseline",
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir – Follow-up",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir – Baseline",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir – Follow-up",
  "INSTI + Abacavir – Baseline",
  "INSTI + Abacavir – Follow-up",
  "Healthy",
  "Cardiovascular",
  "Metabolic"
)

p_up$Group_time <- factor(p_up$Group_time, levels = x_order)

# ---------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------
p_cvd_met <- ggplot(
  p_up,
  aes(
    x     = Group_time,
    y     = NPX,
    group = Group_time
  )
) +
  geom_quasirandom(
    aes(color = Group_color),
    alpha  = 0.7,
    width  = 0.25,
    stroke = 0,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = Group_color),
    color = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Feature, nrow = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 75, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Identified cardiometabolic signatures across treatments and health class",
    x = "Treatment / Reference group",
    y = "NPX"
  )

p_cvd_met

ggsave(filename = "Figure_4H_boxplots_examples.pdf", plot = p_cvd_met, path = "../plots/pdf/boxplot/", width = 16, height = 13)
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# Prepare age data
# ---------------------------
age_df <- metadata %>%
  filter(
    (Disease == "HIV" & Timepoint == "Follow-up" & Subgroup != "Elite controller") |
      Disease %in% c("Healthy") | Class %in% c("Cardiovascular", "Metabolic")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      Disease == "HIV"            ~ "HIV (Follow-up)",
      Disease == "Healthy"        ~ "Healthy",
      Class == "Cardiovascular" ~ "Cardiovascular",
      Class == "Metabolic"      ~ "Metabolic"
    ),
    Age_use = case_when(
      Disease == "HIV"            ~ `Age (follow-up)`,
      Disease != "HIV"            ~ Age,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Age_use), !is.na(Group)) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = fct_reorder(Group, Age_use, .fun = median, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# ---------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------
density_age <- ggplot(
  age_df,
  aes(x = Age_use, y = Group, fill = Group)
) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    alpha = 0.6,
    scale = 1.2,
    rel_min_height = 0.01,
    color = "grey20",
    size = 0.3,
    quantile_lines = TRUE,
    quantiles = 0.5,
    vline_linetype = "solid",
    vline_color = "black",
    vline_size = 0.4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Age distribution across cohorts",
    subtitle = "HIV follow-up compared with Healthy, Cardiovascular, and Metabolic cohorts"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "HIV (Follow-up)" = "#0072B2",
    "Healthy"        = "#71BF6E",
    "Cardiovascular" = "#FC8D62",
    "Metabolic"      = "#E5C494"
  )) +
  theme_hiv()
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

# ---------------------------
# Prepare sex summary data (FIXED)
# ---------------------------
sex_df <- metadata |>
  filter(
    (Disease == "HIV" & Timepoint == "Follow-up" & Subgroup != "Elite controller") |
      Disease == "Healthy" |
      Class %in% c("Cardiovascular", "Metabolic")
  ) %>%
  
  # 🔑 Define groups first
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      Disease == "HIV"          ~ "HIV (Follow-up)",
      Disease == "Healthy"      ~ "Healthy",
      Class == "Cardiovascular" ~ "Cardiovascular",
      Class == "Metabolic"      ~ "Metabolic"
    ),
    
    # 🔑 Clean sex BEFORE counting
    Sex = case_when(
      Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
      Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  
  filter(!is.na(Sex), !is.na(Group)) %>%
  
  count(Group, Sex) %>%
  
  # 🔑 Set order ONCE (no reorder conflict)
  mutate(
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c(
        "HIV (Follow-up)",
        "Healthy",
        "Cardiovascular",
        "Metabolic"
      )
    )
  )

# ---------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------
bar_sex <- ggplot(
  sex_df,
  aes(x = Group, y = n, fill = Sex)
) +
  geom_col(color = "white", width = 0.7) +
  
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "black",
    size = 6
  ) +
  
  coord_flip() +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0)),
    name = "Number of individuals"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Sex distribution across cohorts",
    subtitle = "HIV follow-up compared with Healthy, Cardiovascular, and Metabolic cohorts",
    x = NULL,
    fill = "Sex"
  ) +
  
  theme_hiv()
```

## GSEA

### GO-BP

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(123)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define list of comparisons
# --------------------------------------------------

res_list <- list(
  "HIV vs Healthy"          = de_res_hiv_fu_healthy,
  "CVD vs Healthy"          = cvd_healthy_res,
  "Metabolic vs Healthy"    = met_healthy_res,
  "INSTI (AA) vs Healthy"   = res_instiaa_fu_healthy,
  "INSTI (TE) vs Healthy"   = res_instite_fu_healthy,
  "NNRTI (TE) vs Healthy"   = res_nnrtite_fu_healthy
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Run GSEA (GO BP)
# --------------------------------------------------

gsea_results_go <- lapply(names(res_list), function(name) {
  
  res <- res_list[[name]]
  
  gsea <- hd_gsea(
    res,
    database   = "GO",
    ontology   = "BP",
    ranked_by  = "logFC",
    pval_lim   = 0.05
  )
  
  gsea$enrichment@result |>
    mutate(Comparison = name)
})

gsea_go_all <- bind_rows(gsea_results_go)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Plot
# --------------------------------------------------

p_gsea_go <- gsea_go_all %>%
  group_by(Comparison) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = p.adjust, n = 10) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = Comparison,
    y = reorder(Description, NES),
    color = NES,
    size = -log10(p.adjust)
  )) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  labs(
    x = "Comparison",
    y = "GO Biological Process",
    color = "NES",
    size = "-log10(adj. p-value)"
  ) +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p_gsea_go
```

```{r}
  )) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  labs(
    x = "Comparison",
    y = "Reactome Pathway",
    color = "NES",
    size = "-log10(adj. p-value)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p_gsea_reactome
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(openxlsx)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Thresholds
# --------------------------------------------------

fdr_cutoff   <- 0.05
logfc_cutoff <- 0.5

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Define comparisons (EXCLUDING HIV)
# --------------------------------------------------

res_list <- list(
  "CVD"        = cvd_healthy_res,
  "Metabolic"  = met_healthy_res,
  "INSTI_AA"   = res_instiaa_fu_healthy,
  "INSTI_TE"   = res_instite_fu_healthy,
  "NNRTI_TE"   = res_nnrtite_fu_healthy
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Extract protein sets
# --------------------------------------------------

get_sets <- function(direction = c("up", "down")) {
  
  direction <- match.arg(direction)
  
  lapply(res_list, function(df) {
    
    if (direction == "up") {
      df |> filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, logFC > logfc_cutoff)
    } else {
      df |> filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, logFC < -logfc_cutoff)
    } |>
      pull(Feature) |>
      unique()
  })
}

sets_up   <- get_sets("up")
sets_down <- get_sets("down")

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Create membership matrix
# --------------------------------------------------

create_membership_df <- function(sets_list) {
  
  all_proteins <- unique(unlist(sets_list))
  
  df <- expand.grid(
    Feature = all_proteins,
    Comparison = names(sets_list),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      Present = Feature %in% sets_list[[Comparison]]
    ) |>
    ungroup()
  
  df |> pivot_wider(names_from = Comparison, values_from = Present)
}

df_up_wide   <- create_membership_df(sets_up)
df_down_wide <- create_membership_df(sets_down)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. FIXED overlap labeling (NO rowwise bugs)
# --------------------------------------------------

add_overlap_label <- function(df) {
  
  comparison_cols <- setdiff(colnames(df), "Feature")
  
  df$Overlap <- apply(
    df[, comparison_cols],
    1,
    function(x) {
      present <- comparison_cols[which(x)]
      if (length(present) == 0) return(NA)
      paste(present, collapse = "; ")
    }
  )
  
  df
}

df_up_wide   <- add_overlap_label(df_up_wide)
df_down_wide <- add_overlap_label(df_down_wide)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. Split by overlap
# --------------------------------------------------

split_by_overlap <- function(df) {
  split(df, df$Overlap)
}

overlaps_up   <- split_by_overlap(df_up_wide)
overlaps_down <- split_by_overlap(df_down_wide)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. Write Excel
# --------------------------------------------------

wb <- createWorkbook()

# ---- UP ----
addWorksheet(wb, "UP_all")
writeData(wb, "UP_all", df_up_wide)

for (nm in names(overlaps_up)) {
  
  if (is.na(nm)) next
  
  sheet_name <- paste0("UP_", substr(nm, 1, 25))
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  writeData(wb, sheet_name, overlaps_up[[nm]])
}

# ---- DOWN ----
addWorksheet(wb, "DOWN_all")
writeData(wb, "DOWN_all", df_down_wide)

for (nm in names(overlaps_down)) {
  
  if (is.na(nm)) next
  
  sheet_name <- paste0("DOWN_", substr(nm, 1, 25))
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  writeData(wb, sheet_name, overlaps_down[[nm]])
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# 8. Save
# --------------------------------------------------

saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  "../tables/overlap/protein_overlaps_CVD_MET.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```
